note: Pass criteria marked 'Proposed' are suggestions for the maintainer to confirm. A result counts as hardware only when it was run on real hardware and says so (see docs/TESTING.md).

areas.title: Rendering, shaders and 3D scenes on graphics card vendors

automated.note: compiles every shader on the driver in use
renders every effect and checks the picture
loads and draws the 3D test models
frame times of all factory looks; on software OpenGL these numbers say nothing about a real card

manual.title: Shader compile, selftests and look benchmark on one graphics card
manual.needs: A Windows or Linux PC with one NVIDIA, AMD or Intel graphics card and its current vendor driver
steps: Start a command line in the folder of NyrexVJ.
Run the three selftests (A-RENDER-2 to A-RENDER-4) and note every line that says FAILED.
Run A-RENDER-5 with --bench-budget 16.7 and keep OUT.json.
Write the GL_RENDERER string from OUT.json and the driver version into the result.
manual.measure: Shader failures, selftest exit codes, avg/p95/p99/max work time per look from OUT.json
manual.criteria: Proposed: no shader failure, all three selftests exit 0, every factory look passes the 16.7 ms budget at 1080p. The maintainer sets the real thresholds.

areas.title: Spout output to OBS, Unreal or VRChat capture (Windows)

automated.note: output chain with a fake NDI library; Spout itself only compiles on Windows

manual.title: Spout sender seen by a real receiver
manual.needs: Windows PC with a graphics card and OBS (Spout plugin) or another Spout receiver
steps: Start NyrexVJ with a visible look and turn Spout output on.
Open the receiver and select the NyrexVJ sender.
Run scripts/measure_live.py for 10 minutes while the look plays.
Stop and start NyrexVJ twice and check that the receiver finds the sender again.
manual.measure: Picture correct (orientation, colours), receiver frame rate, CPU and GPU of NyrexVJ and of the receiver
manual.criteria: Proposed: picture upright and correct, receiver rate equals the output rate, sender reappears after a restart without restarting the receiver.

areas.title: Spout input from Unreal or Unity (Windows)

automated.note: feeds a generated pattern through the input path without Spout

manual.title: Spout input from a real sender
manual.needs: Windows PC with a Spout sender (Unreal with a Spout plugin, Unity or a test sender)
steps: Start the sender, then NyrexVJ.
Add the Spout source as a clip and play it.
Close the sender while playing, then start it again.
Run scripts/measure_live.py for 10 minutes.
manual.measure: Picture, behaviour when the sender disappears and returns, CPU, GPU, VRAM
manual.criteria: Proposed: picture correct, the clip falls back to its placeholder when the sender closes and recovers without restarting NyrexVJ.

automated.note: sends through the fake NDI library

manual.title: NDI output seen by a real NDI receiver
manual.needs: Two computers (or one with NDI Studio Monitor) on one network with the NDI runtime installed
steps: Turn NDI output on in NyrexVJ and select it in NDI Studio Monitor or OBS.
Play a look for 10 minutes while scripts/measure_live.py runs.
Unplug the network cable for 10 seconds and plug it in again.
manual.measure: Receiver frame rate, dropped frames at the receiver, CPU and GPU of NyrexVJ
manual.criteria: Proposed: receiver shows the picture, rate matches, the stream returns after the cable is plugged in.

automated.note: plays a test source through the whole live path

manual.title: NDI input from a real sender, with the sender lost and found again
manual.needs: A real NDI sender (OBS NDI plugin, a camera with NDI, another NyrexVJ) and the NDI runtime
steps: Add the NDI source as a clip and play it.
Run NyrexVJ --bench-live 300:ndi:NAME and keep the JSON.
Stop the sender for 30 seconds and start it again.
manual.measure: Latency and dropped-picture numbers from --bench-live, state shown in the Clip window
manual.criteria: Proposed: state goes to reconnecting and back to live without restarting NyrexVJ.

areas.title: Recording the final picture to a video file

automated.note: checks picture orientation, scaling, frame order, the GL state, backpressure, size changes and stalls of the live recording
records the output in every working format and reports capture time, encoder time, drops and file size

manual.title: Hardware encoders on a real graphics card
manual.needs: A graphics card with NVENC, Quick Sync or AMF and an FFmpeg with the matching encoder
steps: Open Settings, Recording and check that the hardware formats are listed.
Record two minutes at 1920 x 1080 and 60 frames per second with each hardware format and with H.264 software.
Play the files in a normal player and check picture, speed and file size.
manual.measure: Encoder name, frame time in NyrexVJ with and without recording, encoder load, dropped frames, CPU and GPU use
manual.criteria: Proposed: the hardware formats record without dropped frames, the frame time rises by less than 0.5 ms and the files play correctly.

manual.title: Recording next to VRChat
manual.needs: A computer that runs VRChat with the usual world and avatar load
steps: Start VRChat and NyrexVJ with the output on a second display.
Record ten minutes in H.264 and in HAP while the VRChat frame time is logged.
Compare the VRChat frame time with and without the recording.
manual.measure: VRChat frame time, NyrexVJ frame time, dropped frames, disk write rate
manual.criteria: Proposed: no frame drops in the recording and no visible change in the VRChat frame time.

manual.title: Sound and picture stay in sync over a long recording
manual.needs: A real audio input or system audio and a file player that shows both tracks
steps: Play a clip with a click track as audio source and record it for one hour.
Open the file and compare the click track with the picture of the clip at the start, the middle and the end.
Repeat once while the program is stalled on purpose for a few seconds.
manual.measure: Offset between picture and sound at the start, middle and end of the file
manual.criteria: Proposed: the offset stays below 40 ms for the whole hour.

manual.title: Full disk and unplugged drive
manual.needs: A small or nearly full drive and a removable drive
steps: Choose the small drive as recording folder and record until it is almost full.
Record to the removable drive and unplug it while recording.
Check the message in the program and open the files that were written.
manual.measure: Message shown, state of the program, state of the file
manual.criteria: Proposed: the program stays responsive, the recording ends with a clear message and the file that was written plays up to that point.

manual.title: Files after a crash
manual.needs: Players and editors the maintainer uses, for example VLC and DaVinci Resolve
steps: Record in H.264, ProRes and HAP with the crash-safe option on and end the program with the task manager.
Open every file in a player and in the editor.
Repeat with the crash-safe option off and note the difference.
manual.measure: Whether the file opens, how much of it plays, how long the editor needs to open it
manual.criteria: Proposed: with the option on, everything recorded up to a few seconds before the crash plays.

automated.note: plays an FFmpeg test source as a camera

manual.title: A real camera or capture card, unplugged and plugged in while playing
manual.needs: A USB camera or a capture card and a cable
steps: Pick the device in the Clip window and play it.
Run NyrexVJ --bench-live 300:camera:NAME.
Unplug the device for 10 seconds while it plays, then plug it in again.
manual.measure: Format chosen by the driver, latency and dropped pictures from --bench-live, state after unplugging
manual.criteria: Proposed: picture shows, state goes to reconnecting and back to live, no crash.

areas.title: Several displays and projectors, hot plugging

automated.note: output windows, mapping and edge blending on the virtual display

manual.title: Fullscreen on a second display or a projector
manual.needs: A second display or a projector
steps: Add an output window in the Outputs panel, assign it to the second display and go fullscreen.
Run scripts/measure_live.py for 10 minutes.
Unplug the display cable for 10 seconds while the output runs, plug it back in and check the window.
manual.measure: Picture on the display, resolution and position, CPU and GPU, what happens to the window when the display disappears
manual.criteria: Proposed: picture correct at the display's native resolution, NyrexVJ keeps running while the display is missing.

automated.note: feeds one message through the real control path

manual.title: A real MIDI controller, unplugged and plugged in while running
manual.needs: A USB MIDI controller (pads or knobs) and, for the clock, a device that sends MIDI clock
steps: Map two controls in the MIDI panel.
Move them for one minute and check the response.
Unplug the controller, plug it in again and move the controls.
manual.measure: Response to controls, response after the device returns, clock tempo against the sender
manual.criteria: Proposed: mapped controls respond, the device is found again without restarting NyrexVJ.

manual.title: Art-Net to a real node or software receiver
manual.needs: An Art-Net node, HNode or QLC+ on the same network
steps: Set the same universe in NyrexVJ and the receiver.
Move a DMX channel in NyrexVJ and watch the receiver.
Run for 10 minutes and note whether the receiver stays in sync.
manual.measure: Channel values at the receiver, packet loss seen by the receiver
manual.criteria: Proposed: values at the receiver follow NyrexVJ without gaps.

areas.title: DJ sync: Pro DJ Link, MIDI clock, timecode

manual.title: Beat sync with a real player or mixer
manual.needs: A Pioneer player or mixer with Pro DJ Link (or a MIDI clock source) on the network
steps: Select the sync source in NyrexVJ and play a track.
Watch the beat indicator against the beat for 5 minutes.
Change the tempo on the player and stop the track.
manual.measure: Beat offset (by eye or with a recorded video), tempo shown in NyrexVJ against the player
manual.criteria: Proposed: beat indicator stays on the beat, tempo follows within one bar of a change.

areas.title: FFmpeg, hardware decoders and the fallback to the processor

automated.note: decodes the test clips with and without graphics card conversion
decode and upload times of one clip

manual.title: Hardware decoding on a real graphics card and the fallback
manual.needs: A graphics card with a hardware decoder (D3D11VA, DXVA2, NVDEC, VA-API or QSV) and an H.264/H.265 test clip
steps: Play the clip with --video-mode auto and note decoder and route in the Clip window.
Repeat with --video-mode software.
Play a clip with a profile the card does not support and check that the processor takes over.
manual.measure: Decoder name, decode time, CPU and GPU use for both modes
manual.criteria: Proposed: automatic mode uses the hardware decoder where available, the fallback shows its reason and playback continues.

areas.title: Long shows: frame times, memory growth, threads and handles over time

automated.note: short smoke run: events, samples and report; too short to judge growth
five minute run with the growth verdict; on software OpenGL only
parsers for nvidia-smi, Windows counters, PowerShell and amdgpu files with sample texts, plus a live check against the own process on Linux
checks this matrix, the results file and the table in docs/TESTING.md

manual.title: Three hour soak on a real graphics card
manual.needs: A PC with a real graphics card, the output resolution of the show and an idle desktop
steps: Run NyrexVJ --fresh --no-update-check --no-welcome --soak 10800 --bench-out soak.json.
In a second window run scripts/measure_live.py --seconds 10800 --out device.json.
Do not touch the PC while it runs.
manual.measure: growth block of soak.json (RSS, GPU estimate, threads, handles), over-budget frames, device.json VRAM curve
manual.criteria: Proposed: no leak verdict, VRAM of the whole card stays flat after the first 25 percent. The soak estimate counts only allocations the program makes itself; device.json is the check against drivers.

areas.title: Restart and recovery after a crash

automated.note: forces a crash and checks the recovery data
starts the program, ends it with kill -9, starts it again and checks that the second run works and ends its session cleanly

manual.title: End the program with the task manager during a show
manual.needs: Any PC
steps: Start NyrexVJ with a saved show, trigger a few clips.
End the process with the task manager (Windows) or kill -9 (Linux).
Start NyrexVJ again.
manual.measure: Time from start to the first picture, what is offered for recovery, state of the last saved show
manual.criteria: Proposed: the program starts, offers the recovery, and the saved show is intact.

areas.title: Running next to VRChat (CPU, GPU and VRAM shared)

manual.title: NyrexVJ and VRChat on the same PC with the show's setup
manual.needs: Windows PC with VRChat, a world with a Spout or NDI capture of NyrexVJ and a real graphics card
steps: Start VRChat in the world and NyrexVJ with the output going to the world.
Run scripts/measure_live.py --seconds 1800 --process NyrexVJ --process VRChat --out parallel.json.
Repeat with NyrexVJ closed to get the VRChat baseline.
manual.measure: CPU, GPU and VRAM of both programs and of the whole card, VRChat frame rate with and without NyrexVJ
manual.criteria: Proposed: the VRChat frame rate drops by less than the maintainer allows; the numbers go into the result either way.

areas.title: Media outages: file removed or truncated while it plays

automated.name: nvj_media_tests
automated.note: includes a video cut at open, cut while playing, overwritten while playing, deleted while playing and opened again after it came back

manual.title: Network share or external drive disappears during playback
manual.needs: A video on a network share or a USB drive
steps: Play the video from the share or drive.
Disconnect the share or drive for 10 seconds, then connect it again.
Trigger the clip again.
manual.measure: Picture while the media is gone, state shown, whether the clip plays again
manual.criteria: Proposed: no crash, no frozen program, the clip reports the problem and plays again after reconnecting.
